"10,000 views" is not a number. It is half of one.

Ten thousand views from 400,000 impressions is a bad post. Ten thousand from 12,000 is a great one. Same headline, opposite businesses.

This is Mosseri's own first piece of advice to creators: look at rates, not raw totals. And it is the single fastest way to stop being fooled by your own dashboard.

Three rates worth more than every vanity metric combined:

→ Sends per reach — how many people DMed it to someone
→ Likes per reach — not likes, likes ÷ reach
→ Average watch time — how long they actually stayed

Totals go up when you post more. Rates only go up when the work gets better. That is why agencies show you totals.
